name: Annandale
description: Flat ground used by British for polo and cricket. Now army helipad and heritage museum.

name: Chadwick Falls
description: 67-meter waterfall surrounded by dense deodar forest. 7 km from the main town. Best during monsoon.

name: Christ Church
description: Second oldest church in North India (1857). Stained glass windows.

name: Green Valley
description: Dense deodar forest valley on the way to Kufri, often used as Bollywood filming location.

name: Himachal State Museum
description: Displays Pahari miniature paintings, sculptures, textiles and colonial-era artifacts of Himachal Pradesh.

name: Jakhoo Temple
description: Hilltop temple with 108-ft Hanuman statue at 8,048 ft — highest point in Shimla with panoramic views.

name: Kalka-Shimla Railway
description: UNESCO World Heritage mountain railway built in 1898. 96 km narrow gauge track through 102 tunnels and 864 bridges.

name: Lakkar Bazaar
description: Famous wood crafts market. Hand-carved walking sticks, toys, and decorative items from local deodar wood.

name: Scandal Point & The Ridge
description: Iconic open space in the heart of Shimla with views of snow-capped mountains. Hub of social life since colonial era.

name: The Mall Road
description: Shimla's main promenade — colonial architecture, bookshops, mountain views.

name: Viceregal Lodge (Indian Institute of Advanced Study)
description: Scottish baronial-style building built in 1888 as summer residence of the British Viceroy. Stunning architecture and gardens.

name: Capitol Complex
description: UNESCO World Heritage Le Corbusier masterpiece. High Court, Secretariat, and Open Hand Monument.

name: Le Corbusier Centre
description: Museum dedicated to the city's architect with original furniture, sketches, and city planning documents.

name: Rock Garden
description: Sculpture park created by Nek Chand using industrial and urban waste. 25 acres of recycled art. UNESCO-acclaimed.

name: Sukhna Lake
description: Man-made lake at the foot of Shivalik Hills. Boating, jogging track, and bird watching.

name: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden
description: Asia's largest rose garden with 1,600 rose varieties across 30 acres. Annual Rose Festival in February.

name: Chitrakote Falls
description: Called "Niagara of India" — widest waterfall in India on the Indravati River. Horseshoe-shaped 95-ft drop.

name: Danteshwari Temple
description: One of 51 Shakti Peethas. 14th-century temple in Dantewada, important Bastar tribal pilgrimage.

name: Kanger Valley National Park
description: Biosphere reserve with Kutumsar Cave (limestone cave with blind fish) and Dandak Cave.

name: Tirathgarh Falls
description: Multi-tiered 300-ft waterfall in Kanger Valley National Park. Steps lead to the base for swimming.

name: Heritage Park
description: Park showcasing replicas of all major monuments of Tripura. Good introduction to the state.

name: Jagannath Temple
description: Main Hindu temple of Agartala with typical Bengali terracotta architecture.

name: Ujjayanta Palace
description: Former royal palace built in 1901. Now Tripura State Museum with tribal art and royal history.

name: Baspa River Walk
description: Scenic walk along the Baspa River with views of snow-capped peaks and apple orchards.

name: Last Indian Village Monument
description: Marker at India's last inhabited village before the Tibet border. Iconic photo spot at 11,319 ft.

name: Mathi Temple
description: Ancient wooden temple dedicated to the local deity Mathi with exquisite Kinnauri wood carvings.

name: Kaziranga Central Range (Kohora)
description: Best range for rhino sightings. Swamp deer, wild buffalo, and elephants also commonly seen.

name: Kaziranga Elephant Safari
description: UNESCO World Heritage park. Elephant and jeep safaris to see one-horned rhinoceros. Highest rhino density globally.

name: National Orchid & Biodiversity Park
description: Park with 500+ orchid species and other rare plants of Northeast India. Educational walking trails.

name: Chaubatia Gardens
description: Sprawling orchards of apple, peach, and plum with Himalayan backdrop. Government fruit research station.

name: Jhula Devi Temple
description: Ancient temple famous for thousands of brass bells hung by devotees whose wishes were fulfilled.

name: Upat Golf Course
description: One of the highest golf courses in Asia at 6,000 ft with Himalayan panorama. Open to visitors.

name: Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib
description: One of five Sikh Takhts. Where Guru Gobind Singh founded the Khalsa in 1699. Houses sacred weapons.

name: Virasat-e-Khalsa
description: Stunning modern museum designed by Moshe Safdie depicting 500 years of Sikh history through multimedia.

name: Raghunath Temple
description: Ancient temple at the confluence point. One of the 108 Divya Desams of Vaishnavism.

name: Sangam (Confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi)
description: Sacred confluence where Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers merge to form the Ganges. Visible color difference.

name: Kokernag Spring
description: Largest freshwater spring in Kashmir. Beautiful Mughal-style garden around the spring with trout fishery.

name: Kokernag Trout Hatchery
description: Government trout breeding center. See rainbow and brown trout in crystal-clear spring water pools.

name: Nako Lake
description: Sacred high-altitude lake at 12,014 ft surrounded by willow trees. Freezes completely in winter.

name: Nako Monastery
description: Buddhist monastery with ancient murals and thangka paintings dating back to the Rinchen Zangpo era.

name: Crocodile Breeding Centre
description: Government centre breeding marsh crocodiles for reintroduction. Dozens of crocs visible in ponds.

name: Tulsi Shyam Hot Springs
description: Natural sulphur hot springs with a temple. Believed to have curative properties. 45 km from Sasan.

name: Doodh Ganga River
description: Crystal-clear milky river flowing through Yusmarg. Trout fishing with permit available.

name: Yusmarg Meadow
description: Pristine meadow at 7,500 ft meaning "Meadow of Jesus". Believed to be where Jesus Christ visited Kashmir.

name: Saikuti Hall
description: Historic hall named after legendary Mizo heroine. Cultural center of southern Mizoram.

name: Rani ki Vav Stepwell
description: UNESCO World Heritage inverted temple. 7 storeys deep, 500+ principal sculptures, 1,000+ minor carvings. Featured on Indian ₹100 note.
